cui_font.name: Font
cui_font.why: The header defines cui_font as int separately from the CUI_FONT_* roles; use the promoted Font enum for both built-in roles and loaded font IDs.

cui_card_opts.name: Card
cui_card_opts.why: Retain the existing concise layout option type alongside Box.

cui_text_opts.nowrap.name: NoWrap
cui_text_opts.nowrap.why: Use normal .NET word casing for the combined C identifier.

cui_input_opts.autofocus.name: AutoFocus
cui_input_opts.autofocus.why: Use normal .NET word casing for the combined C identifier.

cui_table_opts.sort.why: The table wrapper owns a temporary native sort value and writes back through ref TableSort; options must not expose a dangling pointer.

cui_tree_table_opts.sort.why: The sort state the tree table owns and updates; the wrapper keeps it in the frame arena and writes it back.

cui_chat_opts.markdown_result.why: The markdown view's last result, updated by the widget; the wrapper owns it for the call and writes it back.

cui_timeline_editor_opts.view.why: The editor's pan/zoom view, updated by the widget; the wrapper owns it and writes it back.

cui_grid_opts.sort.why: The grid sorts by a table sort the wrapper owns for the call and writes back through ref TableSort.

cui_table_begin_ex.sort.why: Sorting is optional: a table with no sortable columns should not need a throwaway cui_table_sort. Passing a null pointer disables header sorting natively (cui_data.c only reads o->sort when a column is sortable).

cui_heading.level.why: Keep the established default heading level; the header only specifies the valid range 1..4.

cui_rating.max.why: Keep the established default five-star rating.

cui_spinner.size.why: Keep the established default spinner size.

cui_avatar_group.max_visible.why: Keep the established four visible avatars before the overflow badge.

cui_avatar_group.size.why: Keep the established default avatar size in logical points.

cui_meter.unit.why: Keep the established optional unit label; an empty UiText maps to the native null/default value.

cui_gauge.size.why: Keep the established default gauge diameter; native substitutes its own size only when the value is <= 0.

cui_progress_ring.size.why: Keep the established default ring diameter; native substitutes its own size only when the value is <= 0.

cui_file_browser_ex.path_cap.why: A path buffer that covers more than any Windows or POSIX path in practice, so the common call reads `ui.FileBrowser(id, ref path)`.

cui_file_picker_ex.out_cap.why: The picked path fits any real path, so the common call reads `ui.FilePicker(id, ref open, ref path)`.

cui_split_begin.ratio.why: cui_split_begin writes ratio during the call but retains its address until split_next reads it. Copy into the frame arena and write back immediately; a transient LibraryImport pin would leave a movable managed field's address dangling.

cui_date_picker_ex.value.why: cui_date is a native record; convert to the friendly Date and write it back when the call returns.

cui_calendar.value.why: cui_date is a native record; convert to the friendly Date and write it back when the call returns.

cui_color_picker.value.why: cui_color is a native record; convert to the friendly Color and write it back when the call returns.

cui_now_playing_ex.np.why: The player state is an in/out record: the value is converted for the call and written back, so no pointer outlives it.

cui_range_calendar.range.why: The selected range is an in/out record: converted for the call and written back.

cui_date_range_picker_ex.range.why: The selected range is an in/out record: converted for the call and written back.

cui_shortcut_recorder_ex.combo.why: The recorded shortcut is an in/out record: converted for the call and written back.

cui_node_editor_begin_ex.view.why: The pan/zoom view is an in/out record: converted for the call and written back.

cui_prop_color_ex.value.why: The edited color is an in/out value: converted for the call and written back.

cui_flame_span_rect.span.why: The span is read-only input and nothing retains it: converted for the call.

cui_hex_view_ex.sel.why: The selection is an in/out record: converted for the call and written back.

cui_citation.source.why: The source is read-only input and nothing retains it: converted for the call.

cui_flame_graph_ex.view.why: The pan/zoom view is an in/out record: converted for the call and written back.

cui_month_calendar_ex.month.why: The shown month, converted for the call and read back when the arrows, Today or the keys move it.

cui_image_viewer_ex.view.why: Zoom and centre, converted for the call and read back after panning or zooming.

cui_cropper_ex.crop.why: The crop rectangle, converted for the call and read back after dragging.

cui_row_begin.why: Rows use the box stack and do not export a separate row_end function.

cui_column_begin.why: Columns use the box stack and do not export a separate column_end function.

cui_card_begin.why: The bool return reports clicked, not openness; cui_card_begin always opens its layout container.

cui_icon.why: Drawing primitive with a theme-aware default color; retained with the manual drawing partial.

cui_line_chart_ex.why: Charts take managed series and decimate long feeds into the frame arena; auto-decimation is Phase 2, Step 3.

cui_bar_chart_ex.why: Charts take managed series and decimate long feeds into the frame arena; auto-decimation is Phase 2, Step 3.

cui_donut_chart_ex.why: Charts take managed series and decimate long feeds into the frame arena; auto-decimation is Phase 2, Step 3.

cui_image_create.why: Texture handle ownership and pixel upload belong with the typed image API in Phase 2, Step 3.

cui_image_load.why: Texture handle ownership and out-parameters belong with the typed image API in Phase 2, Step 3.

cui_image_destroy.why: Texture handle ownership belongs with the typed image API in Phase 2, Step 3.

cui_reorder_begin.why: Native code keeps the order array until reorder_end; the manual wrapper owns a stable frame-arena copy and writes the managed array back on ReorderEnd.

cui_reorder_item_begin.why: Reorder keeps a per-list build state until reorder_end, so the manual wrapper keeps the scope and write-back in one place.

cui_reorder_end.why: Reorder end returns whether the order changed and writes the managed array back; kept with the manual reorder wrapper.

cui_date_today.why: Returns a native cui_date without a context; DateToday() lives with the manual date helpers.

cui_set_theme.why: The `ui.Theme` setter (Ui.Frame.cs) sits next to `ui.Accent` and `ui.ToggleTheme`; the rest of the Theme section stays excluded.

cui_set_accent.why: The `ui.Accent` setter (Ui.Frame.cs) sits next to `ui.Theme`; the rest of the Theme section stays excluded.

cui_request_redraw.why: Ui.RequestRedraw is the draw-time hook for animations; frame ownership itself stays with CuiSurface.

cui_needs_redraw.why: Ui.NeedsRedraw exposes the draw-time redraw query; the rest of the frame lifecycle stays with CuiSurface.

cui_input_ex.why: The field's storage is an unmanaged buffer per id; ui.Input/TextArea/Search own the TextFieldPool slot and decode only on change.

cui_textarea_ex.why: The field's storage is an unmanaged buffer per id; ui.Input/TextArea/Search own the TextFieldPool slot and decode only on change.

cui_search_ex.why: The field's storage is an unmanaged buffer per id; ui.Input/TextArea/Search own the TextFieldPool slot and decode only on change.

cui_number_ex.why: Numeric editing binds a ref double directly; kept beside the other text fields.

cui_tag_input_ex.why: Comma-separated tags live in the same per-id buffer pool as Input, so it shares the manual text wrappers.

cui_otp_input.why: The one-time code lives in the per-id buffer pool with capacity length + 1.

cui_terminal_ex.why: It draws a terminal whose buffer (text plus a line ring) the app owns: `Terminal` in Ui.Terminal.cs owns that storage and calls the raw function.

cui_request_wakeup.why: A delayed wakeup timer: wrapped by hand in Ui.Terminal.cs as `ui.RequestWakeup(seconds)` beside the immediate RequestRedraw.

cui_last_id.why: `ui.LastId` in Ui.Overlays.cs, next to the hand-written Id/Keyed scopes: it is the id of the widget just drawn, which the guided tour and the other point-at-this APIs take.

cui_draw_rect.why: `ui.DrawRect` (Ui.Draw.cs): a RectF and a radius, no corners struct.

cui_draw_rect_border.why: `ui.DrawRect(rect, fill, border, width, radius)` (Ui.Draw.cs): the border overload.

cui_draw_shadow.why: `ui.DrawShadow` (Ui.Draw.cs): blur, spread and offset as named arguments.

cui_draw_polyline.why: `ui.DrawPolyline` (Ui.Draw.cs): takes (X, Y) tuples instead of a float array.

cui_canvas.why: `ui.Canvas` (Ui.Draw.cs): a PaintFn plus a CanvasResult with rect/hover/pressed/clicked.

cui_state.why: `ui.State<T>(id)` (Ui.Draw.cs): a Span<T> over CUI's per-id storage.

cui_measure_text.why: `ui.MeasureText` (Ui.Frame.cs) returns a TextMetrics with width, height, ascent, descent and line height.

cui_push_disabled.why: `ui.Disabled(bool)` and `ui.Disabled(bool, body)` (Ui.Frame.cs): a DisabledScope the caller closes.

cui_key_name.why: `Ui.KeyName(Key)` (Ui.Frame.cs): the label the UI shows for a key.

cui_shortcut.why: `ui.Shortcut(mods, key)` (Ui.Overlays.cs): unmodified while a text field has focus.

cui_color_of.why: `ui.ColorOf(color)` (Ui.Frame.cs) resolves a token to channels the frame is drawing with.

cui_oklch.why: `Color.Oklch(l, c, hue, alpha)` (Interop/Types.cs): the space the themes are built in.

cui_theme_get.why: `ui.TokenColor` and `CuiSurface`/`CuiApp` own the theme pointer; the raw struct stays internal.

cui_last_hovered.why: `ui.Canvas` reports Hovered through CanvasResult; the raw id stays internal.

cui_set_renderer.why: `CuiSurface.Create` installs the software renderer; CuiApp lets CUI pick (CuiSurface.cs).

cui_begin_frame.why: `CuiSurface.BeginFrame` and CUI's own loop for a window (CuiSurface.cs).

cui_next_wakeup.why: The host loop uses it through `cui_app_frame`; `ui.RequestWakeup` sets it from draw code.

cui_app_frame.why: `CuiApp.Frame`, the explicit loop for tools and tests (CuiApp.cs).

cui_app_run.why: `CuiApp.Run` installs the frame callback so a modal resize keeps drawing (CuiApp.cs).

cui_app_file_dialog.why: `CuiWindow.PickFile` (CuiWindow.cs) returns a FilePickResult: picked, cancelled or failed, with the path.

cui_sw_set_incremental.why: `CuiSurface.Incremental` (CuiSurface.cs): the software renderer then redraws only the damaged part of the frame.

cui_sw_last_damage.why: `CuiSurface.LastDamage` (CuiSurface.cs) reports the rectangle the last render touched.

cui_write_png.why: `CuiSurface` renders to a pixel buffer; PNG writing is the caller's (or `CUI_SCREENSHOT`).

cui_gl_create.why: CuiApp lets CUI create the GL context; CuiSharp never drives GL itself.

cui_gl_destroy.why: CuiApp lets CUI destroy the GL context.

cui_gl_iface.why: CuiApp lets CUI manage the GL renderer.

cui_gl_render.why: CuiApp renders through CUI's own loop.

cui_terminal_init.why: The `Terminal` facade (Ui/Terminal.cs) owns the text block and line ring and calls it once in its constructor.

cui_terminal_write.why: `Terminal.Write`/`WriteLine` (Ui/Terminal.cs) call it with the pooled UTF-8 bytes.

cui_log_init.why: The `LogBuffer` facade (Ui/LogBuffer.cs) owns the line ring and text block and calls it once in its constructor.

cui_log_append_text.why: `LogBuffer.Append`/`AppendLine` (Ui/LogBuffer.cs). The variadic `cui_log_append` stays skipped: C# formats first.

cui_curve_eval.why: `CuiMath.EvaluateCurve(keys, x)` (Ui/CuiMath.cs): the same evaluation the curve editor draws with.

cui_diff_words.why: `CuiMath.DiffWords(old, new)` (Ui/CuiMath.cs) returns the changed byte ranges, or null when marks would not help.

cui_input_mouse_move.why: Platform input: the Win32/X11/Cocoa backends feed it for a window, and `CuiSurface.MouseMove` feeds it headless (CuiSurface.Input.cs).

cui_input_mouse_button.why: `CuiSurface.MouseDown`/`MouseUp`/`Click` (CuiSurface.Input.cs); the backends call it for a window.

cui_input_text.why: `CuiSurface.Type(text)` (CuiSurface.Input.cs) delivers UTF-8 as the keyboard layout would.

cui_diff_compute.why: `CuiMath.DiffLines(old, new)` (Ui/CuiMath.cs) returns the hunks and the stats, including whether the diff had to approximate.

cui_path_has_extension.why: `CuiMath.PathMatches(path, filter)` (Ui/CuiMath.cs): the same matching rule the file picker applies to `*.png;*.jpg`.

cui_hex_view_ex.why: `ui.HexView(id, Span<byte>, ref HexSelection, opts)` (Ui/Ui.Hex.cs) pins the caller's own memory, so a typed byte lands in the array the caller holds; the generated read-only overload copies into the frame arena.

cui_fs_list.why: `CuiFiles.ListDirectory(path)` (Ui/CuiFiles.cs) fills the entries and parses the name blob, sorted directories first; the file browser passes it to native as its own default lister.

cui_flame_sort.why: `CuiFiles.SortFlameSpans(spans)` (Ui/CuiFiles.cs) sorts a caller's FlameSpan array in place.

cui_markdown_apply_task.why: `MarkdownText.ToggleTask(ref text, offset, result)` (Ui/CuiMath.cs) flips the checkbox an interactive markdown view reported.

cui_diff_view_rows.why: `ui.DiffRows(id, Span<DiffRow>)` (Ui/Ui.Diff.cs) copies the live view's rows into the caller's span and returns the total, so a custom renderer or a test can read them without allocating.

cui_tree_table_begin_ex.why: `ui.TreeTable(id, columns, nodes, row, …)` (Ui/Ui.TreeTable.cs) pins the caller's `TreeNode[]` so the table's open/selected/loading writes land in it, and rents the label delegate through the frame-callback bridge.

cui_tree_table_end.why: `ui.TreeTable` returns its `TreeTableEvents`, with the lazy-load ids copied out of frame memory (Ui/Ui.TreeTable.cs).

cui_tree_sort.why: `CuiTree.Sort(nodes, root, compare)` (Ui/Ui.TreeTable.cs) passes a comparator through the frame-callback bridge and relinks every sibling list in place.

cui_state_on_free.why: `ui.State<T>(id, onFree)` (Ui.Draw.cs) reserves a state block whose header holds the callback, and the frame-callback bridge supplies the disposer CUI calls when it evicts that id.

cui_virtual_list_begin.first.why: The header documents that the visible range is filled in, so an out parameter is the honest shape.

cui_virtual_list_begin.last.why: The header documents that the visible range is filled in, so an out parameter is the honest shape.

cui_image_compare_ex.pos.why: Before/after slider position: the widget drags it, so the wrapper takes it as out and returns the new value.

cui_waveform_ex.progress.why: Playback position: clicking the waveform seeks, so the wrapper takes it as out and returns the new value.

Context and frame.why: Frame lifecycle belongs to CuiSurface/CuiApp, not to a draw-time Ui value.

Input (called by the platform layer).why: Platform input is delivered by the window backend and the test harness, not by draw code.

cui_app.why: Window/app ownership belongs to CuiApp; CuiSurface exposes the supported subset.

cui_render.why: Renderer interfaces are consumed by CuiSurface and the software raster path, not by Ui.

Draw data (consumed by renderers).why: Draw data is consumed by external renderers; CuiSurface exposes it.

Identity.why: ui.Id/Keyed id scopes are hand-written in Step 3 with the extension composition API; raw push/pop stay internal.

Custom drawing.why: Drawing primitives keep ergonomic overloads (radius, RectF, Color) in the manual drawing partial.

Fonts.why: Font loading and measuring belong to CuiSurface/CuiApp bootstrapping, not to per-frame draw code.

Theme.why: Theme control belongs to CuiApp (SetTheme/SetAccent); Ui keeps request-redraw only.

cui_choice.name: Choice
cui_choice.why: Radio card items are built by callers as a small immutable record, not a native array entry.

cui_command.name: Command
cui_command.why: Command palette rows are built by callers as a small record with optional icon, group and shortcut.

cui_table_column.name: TableColumn
cui_table_column.why: Table columns are built by callers; the friendly record keeps Size/TextAlign/bool instead of the native field types.

cui_table_sort.name: TableSort
cui_table_sort.why: The sort state is caller-owned and round-trips through the table wrapper, so it needs a writable friendly record.

cui_viz_item.name: VizItem
cui_viz_item.why: One slice, stage, tile or ring: a label, a value and a color. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_tab_bar_item.name: TabBarItem
cui_tab_bar_item.why: One tab: icon, label and badge. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_reaction.name: Reaction
cui_reaction.why: One emoji reaction with its count and state; read back after the widget runs.

cui_speed_action.name: SpeedAction
cui_speed_action.why: One fan-out action: icon and label. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_ticker_item.name: TickerItem
cui_ticker_item.why: One scrolling ticker entry. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_plan_step.name: PlanStep
cui_plan_step.why: One step of an agent plan: title, detail, status. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_source.name: Source
cui_source.why: One document an answer used: title, url, snippet. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_prompt_suggestion.name: PromptSuggestion
cui_prompt_suggestion.why: One suggested prompt: icon, title, detail. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_model.name: Model
cui_model.why: One model in the picker: name, detail, badge, icon. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_toc_item.name: TocItem
cui_toc_item.why: One table-of-contents entry: title, anchor, level. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_check_step.name: CheckStep
cui_check_step.why: One checklist step with a done flag; read back after the widget runs.

cui_cal_event.name: CalendarEvent
cui_cal_event.why: One calendar entry; the widget only reads it, so the wrapper copies it.

cui_gantt_task.name: GanttTask
cui_gantt_task.why: One gantt row; the widget only reads it, so the wrapper copies it.

cui_diff_row.name: DiffRow
cui_diff_row.why: One diff row: kind, line numbers, change group and fold size.

cui_grid_column.name: GridColumn
cui_grid_column.why: One data-grid column: title, width, alignment, sorting and priority.

cui_sankey_link.name: SankeyLink
cui_sankey_link.why: One sankey edge: from, to, value.

cui_path_bar_result.name: PathBarResult
cui_path_bar_result.why: What a path bar reported this frame: clicked segment, submitted text, editing state.

cui_markdown_result.name: MarkdownResult
cui_markdown_result.why: What a markdown view reported: clicked link, hovered link, toggled task box.

cui_code_editor_result.name: CodeEditorResult
cui_code_editor_result.why: Editor state after the frame: changed/refused/focused, caret, selection, bracket match.

cui_diff_result.name: DiffResult
cui_diff_result.why: Diff summary after the frame: counts, current change, folds.

cui_flame_result.name: FlameResult
cui_flame_result.why: What a flame graph reported: selection and view changes, hovered and zoomed span.

cui_curve_result.name: CurveResult
cui_curve_result.why: Curve editor state: changed keys, selection, hover position.

cui_gradient_result.name: GradientResult
cui_gradient_result.why: Gradient editor state: changed stops and the selection.

cui_doc_tabs_result.name: DocTabsResult
cui_doc_tabs_result.why: What document tabs reported: selection change, tab to close, tab moved.

cui_doc_tab.name: DocTab
cui_doc_tab.why: One document tab: title, icon, tooltip, dirty flag. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_flame_span.name: FlameSpan
cui_flame_span.why: One flame-graph span: name, start, end, depth, color key. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_hex_selection.name: HexSelection
cui_hex_selection.why: A hex-view selection: start, length and cursor. Written back after the widget runs.

cui_now_playing.name: NowPlayingState
cui_now_playing.why: A player's state: title, artist, art, position, duration, playing. Written back after the widget runs.

cui_date_range.name: DateRange
cui_date_range.why: A start and end date. Written back after the widget runs.

cui_key_combo.name: KeyCombo
cui_key_combo.why: A recorded shortcut: modifiers and key. Written back after the recorder runs.

cui_node_view.name: NodeView
cui_node_view.why: Node-editor pan and zoom. Written back after the editor runs.

cui_filter_field.name: FilterField
cui_filter_field.why: One filter field: name, icon and its options. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_series.name: Series
cui_series.why: One chart series: name, samples, color. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper; the sample count is the array length.

cui_presence_user.name: PresenceUser
cui_presence_user.why: One presence avatar: name, color, texture, idle flag. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_hex_result.name: HexResult
cui_hex_result.why: What a hex view reported: selection, flags, edit range, hovered byte.

cui_flame_view.name: FlameView
cui_flame_view.why: Flame-graph pan and zoom. Written back after the graph runs.

cui_vec2.name: Vec2
cui_vec2.why: A point: x and y. Used by scatter series and path data.

cui_curve_key.name: CurveKey
cui_curve_key.why: One curve key: position, handles, mode. The curve editor writes the array back.

cui_gradient_stop.name: GradientStop
cui_gradient_stop.why: One gradient stop: position and color. The gradient editor writes the array back.

cui_log_line.name: LogLine
cui_log_line.why: One log line read back from a log buffer.

cui_timeline_editor_result.name: TimelineEditorResult
cui_timeline_editor_result.why: What a timeline editor reported: changes, scrub state, playback, selection.

cui_kanban_move.name: KanbanMove
cui_kanban_move.why: A card moved between columns: card, from, to, index.

cui_timeline_view.name: TimelineView
cui_timeline_view.why: Editor pan and zoom: scroll position, zoom and track height.

cui_swipe_action.name: SwipeAction
cui_swipe_action.why: One swipe action: icon, label and tone. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_scatter_series.name: ScatterSeries
cui_scatter_series.why: One scatter series: name, points, sizes, color. Copied into the frame arena by the wrapper.

cui_hex_range.name: HexRange
cui_hex_range.why: One highlighted byte range: offset, length and color.

cui_gauge_band.name: GaugeBand
cui_gauge_band.why: One radial gauge band: everything up to `to` takes the band's tone.

cui_candle.name: Candle
cui_candle.why: One candlestick: open, high, low, close and volume.

cui_tour_step.name: TourStep
cui_tour_step.why: One guided-tour step: the target control and where its card sits.

cui_month_event.name: MonthEvent
cui_month_event.why: One all-day or timed event on the month calendar.

cui_month_result.name: MonthResult
cui_month_result.why: What the month calendar reported this frame.

cui_file_entry.name: FileEntry
cui_file_entry.why: One directory entry as `cui_fs_list` describes it.

cui_file_browser_result.name: FileBrowserResult
cui_file_browser_result.why: What the file browser reported this frame.

cui_terminal_result.name: TerminalResult
cui_terminal_result.why: The line the terminal accepted this frame.

cui_image_view.name: ImageView
cui_image_view.why: An image viewer's zoom and centre, in image pixels.

cui_chart_opts.name: MaxPoints
cui_chart_opts.why: Upper bound on drawn points. 0 derives twice the viewport width; longer series are min/max decimated into the frame arena.

cui_diff_compute.why: C helper: computes a diff into caller memory. Not a frame call; the widgets that show a diff wrap it.

cui_diff_words.why: C helper: word-level diff for the inline diff view. Internal to cui_diff_compute.

cui_tree_sort.why: Sorts a caller-owned `cui_tree_node` model through a `int (*cmp)(void *, int, int)` comparator: a managed-delegate bridge with an owned GCHandle, for a model whose nodes the C# side does not wrap yet (the tree table draws from `Tree`).

cui_markdown_apply_task.why: C helper: applies a task-box toggle to markdown text. Model manipulation, not drawing.

cui_date_to_days.why: C helper: date to day number. Belongs in a static utility class with the rest of the date maths.

cui_date_from_days.why: C helper: day number to date. Belongs in a static utility class with the rest of the date maths.

cui_key_name.why: C helper: key code to display name. A static utility, and the widgets that need it already print the name.

cui_flame_sort.why: C helper: sorts flame spans by weight. Data preparation, not drawing.

cui_curve_eval.why: C helper: evaluates a curve at x. Data preparation for custom drawing; the editor wraps what it needs.

cui_gradient_eval.why: C helper: evaluates a gradient at t. Data preparation for custom drawing.

cui_log_init.why: Log writer with process-wide state: belongs in a separate logging facade, not on a frame-local Ui.

cui_log_appendv.why: Takes a C `va_list`, which a managed caller cannot supply. `LogBuffer.AppendLine` formats in C# and calls `cui_log_append_text`, the same entry point without the variadic wrapper.

cui_log_append_text.why: Log writer with process-wide state: belongs in a separate logging facade, not on a frame-local Ui.

cui_log_clear.why: Log writer with process-wide state: belongs in a separate logging facade, not on a frame-local Ui.

cui_log_get.why: Log writer with process-wide state: belongs in a separate logging facade, not on a frame-local Ui.

cui_path_has_extension.why: C helper: string test. Nothing to wrap on a Ui.

cui_signature_points.why: Takes a caller-built `const cui_vec2 **`, i.e. a jagged C array. Signature capture is not needed by any sample; wrapping it would need an ownership rule nothing uses yet.

cui_diff_view_rows.why: Fills a caller-owned array of diff rows for a custom renderer. The diff view already wraps the same layout; an array out-parameter needs a copy-back rule nothing uses yet.

cui_log_view_ex.why: Renders a log buffer whose layout is a `cui_log_buffer` with internal ring pointers: it belongs with the log writer facade, not on a frame-local Ui.

cui_timeline_editor_ex.why: A timeline track holds three nested arrays (keys, clips, selections), so the record would need array-of-record support one level deeper than the generator has. Available through the raw layer.

cui_hex_view_ex.why: Its options point at writable bytes the view overwrites in place. That is a caller-owned buffer contract the wrapper cannot police; the hex viewer stays available through the raw layer, and `HexResult`/`HexSelection` are still exposed.

cui_fs_list.why: The default directory reader. It fills a caller-owned entry array and name blob for `cui_file_browser_ex`; an app that browses the filesystem uses the browser, and one that does not gets it from the facade.

cui_terminal_init.why: Fills a caller-owned terminal buffer (`char *text` plus a line array). CuiSharp's `Terminal` facade owns that storage; see Ui.Terminal.cs.

cui_terminal_write.why: Appends to a caller-owned terminal buffer. Exposed through the `Terminal` facade, which owns the buffer and keeps it valid.

cui_terminal_clear.why: Resets a caller-owned terminal buffer. Exposed through the `Terminal` facade.

cui_state_on_free.why: Registers a `void (*)(cui_ctx *, void *)` disposer for per-id state: a managed-delegate bridge with an owned GCHandle, which the wrapper does not offer yet.

cui_tree_table_begin_ex.why: Its `_end` returns a `cui_tree_table_events` struct holding a frame-memory `const int *load` plus its count: a record cannot carry a span, and copying it into an array every frame would allocate on the hot path. Rows, names and depths are wrapped; the lazy-load list stays raw.

cui_heatmap_ex.values.why: A matrix arrives row-major and native derives the length from rows*cols, so the wrapper only checks it.

cui_calendar_heatmap_ex.values.why: One value per day: the length is the days parameter.

cui_hex_view_ex.data.why: The byte count is `size` (a size_t), not a count parameter.

cui_level_meter_ex.levels.why: One peak per channel, and `channels` is already a parameter: the wrapper checks the array against it.

cui_shortcut_label.why: Returns a formatted shortcut in CUI frame memory: the wrapper copies it into a managed string.

cui_emoji_picker_ex.why: Returns the picked emoji as a UTF-8 string in frame memory, or NULL while nothing is picked.

cui_inline_edit_ex.buf.why: An editable label: the text is a pooled string the caller owns, and CUI edits it in place.

cui_code_editor_ex.buf.why: An editor over a caller-owned string; the text comes back on the frames the editor changed it.

cui_chat_composer_ex.buf.why: A composer over a caller-owned string; the flags say whether the text changed.

cui_filter_bar.search.why: The filter bar's search box, as a pooled string.

cui_data_grid_edit.buf.why: The grid's inline editor before it starts; its own id because the function has none.

cui_data_grid_cell_edit.buf.why: The cell editor's text; its own id because the function has none.

cui_dock_save.buf.why: The dock layout as a string the caller can persist; written when the layout fits.

cui_prop_text_ex.buf.why: A property row's editable text, keyed by its label.

cui_file_browser_ex.path.why: The folder being browsed: the widget navigates it, so the wrapper rents it, passes it, and reads it back.

cui_file_picker_ex.out.why: The picked path is written into this buffer when the dialog closes.

cui_swipe_item_begin.why: The end call reports which swipe action was taken, or -1, so the body overload returns it.

cui_card_stack_begin.why: The end call reports which card in the stack is active, or -1, so the body overload returns it.

cui_reorder_item_begin.why: The end call reports the item's new position, or -1 when it did not move.

cui_kanban_begin.why: The card was dropped into another column, and the move is written into the out parameter.

cui_grid_opts.selected.why: The selected row: the grid moves it, so the wrapper takes a ref bool and writes it back.

cui_diff_opts.current.why: The current change: the view moves it with the keys, so the wrapper writes it back.

cui_comment_opts.likes.why: The like count: clicking the reaction changes it, so the wrapper writes it back.

cui_response_actions_opts.vote.why: The vote: -1, 0 or 1, changed by the buttons, so the wrapper writes it back.

cui_composer_opts.removed.why: The attachment whose x was clicked, or -1: written back after the composer runs.

cui_tool_opts.toggle.why: The switch state of a tool row, written back after the widget runs.

cui_curve_opts.selected.why: The selected curve key, written back after the editor runs.

cui_gradient_opts.selected.why: The selected gradient stop, written back after the editor runs.

cui_tree_table_opts.cursor.why: The focused row, moved by the keys: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_comment_opts.liked.why: Whether the comment is liked, toggled by the button: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_timeline_editor_opts.in.why: The in-point of the selection, moved by dragging: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_grid_opts.cursor.why: The focused cell, moved by the keys: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_timeline_editor_opts.out.why: The out-point of the selection, moved by dragging: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_grid_opts.anchor.why: The anchor row of a range selection, moved by shift-click: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_composer_opts.model.why: The chosen model index, changed by the model picker: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_timeline_editor_opts.current_track.why: The focused track, moved by the keys: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_timeline_editor_opts.current_key.why: The focused key, moved by the keys: the wrapper writes it back.

cui_month_opts.selected.why: The selected day, which the calendar both reads and sets: `ref Date` beside the options.

cui_emoji_picker_opts.tone.why: The skin tone the picker changes (0 none .. 5 dark): `ref int` beside the options.

left@cui_swipe_item_begin.why: A swipe row takes both action arrays by pointer, with left_count and right_count as their lengths; the singular name alone reads as one value.

right@cui_swipe_item_begin.why: A swipe row takes both action arrays by pointer, with left_count and right_count as their lengths; the singular name alone reads as one value.

stages@cui_funnel_ex.why: Funnel stages are an array despite the singular name; count follows.

series@cui_scatter_chart_ex.why: Scatter series are an array of records; count follows.

cui_heatmap_opts.row_labels.why: One label per row: native reads `rows` entries, so the wrapper rejects a short array.

cui_heatmap_opts.col_labels.why: One label per column: native reads `cols` entries, so the wrapper rejects a short array.

cui_candlestick_opts.labels.why: One axis label per candle: native reads `count` labels, so the wrapper rejects a shorter array.

cui_month_opts.month_names.why: Twelve month names, January first: native reads all twelve, so the wrapper rejects a shorter array.

cui_emoji_picker_opts.group_names.why: Ten group names, recent first: native reads all ten, so the wrapper rejects a shorter array.

cui_month_opts.day_names.why: Seven short day names, Monday first: native reads all seven, so the wrapper rejects a shorter array.

cui_curve_editor_ex.keys.why: The editor moves, adds and removes keys: the wrapper copies the array and its count back.

cui_gradient_editor_ex.stops.why: The editor moves, adds and removes stops: the wrapper copies the array and its count back.

cui_file_browser_opts.list.why: A `cui_file_list_fn` callback for a custom directory source. Left null, native uses its own `cui_fs_list`, which is what an app wants.

cui_file_browser_opts.list_user.why: The `void *` handed to the list callback above.

cui_file_picker_opts.list.why: A `cui_file_list_fn` callback for a custom directory source. Left null, native uses its own `cui_fs_list`.

cui_file_picker_opts.list_user.why: The `void *` handed to the list callback above.

cui_hex_view_opts.edit.why: Writable bytes the view overwrites in place. The wrapper copies `Data` into the frame arena (so it stays valid for the call), which means an in-place edit would be written to a copy and lost; the read-only viewer works, editing needs the raw layer until the view owns its buffer.

cui_tree_table_opts.label.why: A C function pointer: `ui.TreeTable(..., label)` passes it and its user pointer through the frame-callback bridge, so the struct field stays zero here (Ui/Ui.TreeTable.cs).

cui_tree_table_opts.user.why: The `void *` for the label callback above; the bridge supplies the GCHandle address for it.

cui_fader_opts.meter.why: The fader's meter takes `meter_channels` peaks, not `meter_count`.

cui_emoji_picker_opts.recent.why: The picker keeps the app's recent list, newest first: the wrapper rents a pooled buffer, passes it, and reads the edited list back.

cui_emoji_supported.len.why: The wrapper NUL-terminates the string it passes, and native reads a negative length as `up to the terminator`.

cui_draw_emoji.len.why: The wrapper NUL-terminates the string it passes, and native reads a negative length as `up to the terminator`.

cui_segmented_ex.why: Each segment is its own control: a test clicks 'Dark', not the middle of the strip.

cui_tabs_ex.why: Each tab is its own control: a test clicks 'Markets', not the middle of the strip.
